whenToUse: Use designsetgo/tabs for tabbed content where each panel is worth seeing on its own but all belong to the same topic — product specs, pricing tiers, documentation sections. It supports vertical orientation and a mobile mode (accordion, dropdown, or plain tabs) so it stays usable on small screens. Every child must be a designsetgo/tab; tab is not a standalone block.
avoid: Do not add a designsetgo/tab outside a designsetgo/tabs — tab declares designsetgo/tabs as its only valid parent.
Do not leave a tab's innerBlocks empty — a tab panel with no content has nothing to show when selected.
Do not use tabs for only one or two short pieces of content that could just be shown directly on the page — tabs add interaction cost that only pays off with several substantial panels.
Do not forget mobileMode on a long or many-tab set — the default ("accordion") is usually right, but confirm it matches the content instead of leaving it unconsidered.
